ops.new:
-- rc9: colours per name family (zone / spell / NPC / class / item / term / object).
-- F.db.col = { on = true, zn = "green", cls = "class", ... }; no entry = the default
-- below, "off" = no colour, "class" (cls only) = the official class colour.
-- Colour codes only ride on text in display modes 1 and 2: mode 3 reorders the
-- characters itself and a hex code inside would be reversed with them.
T.COL_PALETTE = { "green", "blue", "gold", "orange", "red", "purple", "cyan", "pink", "white" }
T.COL_HEX = { green = "4cd964", blue = "5ac8fa", gold = "ffd24a", orange = "ff9f43", red = "ff6b6b",
    purple = "c58cff", cyan = "3de3d0", pink = "ff8fc7", white = "ffffff" }
T.COL_DEFAULT = { zn = "green", sp = "blue", npc = "orange", cls = "class" }
T.COL_FAMS = { "zn", "sp", "npc", "cls", "it", "tm", "ob" }
local CLASS_HEX = { warrior = "c79c6e", paladin = "f58cba", hunter = "abd473", rogue = "fff569",
    priest = "ffffff", shaman = "0070de", mage = "69ccf0", warlock = "9482c9", druid = "ff7d0a",
    ["death knight"] = "c41f3b", monk = "00ff96", ["demon hunter"] = "a330c9", evoker = "33937f" }

function T.ColorOf(fam, en)
    local c = F.db and F.db.col
    if type(c) ~= "table" or not c.on or T.Mode() == 3 then
        return nil
    end
    local id = c[fam]
    if id == nil then
        id = T.COL_DEFAULT[fam]
    end
    if id == "class" then
        if fam ~= "cls" then
            return nil
        end
        local l = string.lower(tostring(en or ""))
        return CLASS_HEX[l] or CLASS_HEX[(string.gsub(l, "s$", ""))]
    end
    return T.COL_HEX[id]
end

local function col_ids(fam)
    local ids = { "off" }
    for _, id in ipairs(T.COL_PALETTE) do
        ids[#ids + 1] = id
    end
    if fam == "cls" then
        ids[#ids + 1] = "class"
    end
    return ids
end

local function col_db()
    if not F.db then
        return {}
    end
    if type(F.db.col) ~= "table" then
        F.db.col = {}
    end
    return F.db.col
end

local function col_refresh()
    if T.RefreshAll then
        T.RefreshAll()
    end
    F:Fire("names")
    F:Fire("disp")
end

function F.ColLabels(fam)
    local out = {}
    for i, id in ipairs(col_ids(fam)) do
        out[i] = (L.col_id and L.col_id[id]) or id
    end
    return out
end

function F.ColId(fam)
    return col_db()[fam] or T.COL_DEFAULT[fam] or "off"
end

function F.ColIndex(fam)
    local id = F.ColId(fam)
    for i, x in ipairs(col_ids(fam)) do
        if x == id then
            return i
        end
    end
    return 1
end

function F.ColHex(fam) -- the colour of the choice itself (the class choice previews gold)
    local id = F.ColId(fam)
    return T.COL_HEX[id] or (id == "class" and "ffd24a") or nil
end

function F.ColSet(fam, idx)
    col_db()[fam] = col_ids(fam)[idx] or "off"
    col_refresh()
end

function F.ColSetOn(v)
    col_db().on = v and true or false
    col_refresh()
end

-- {{fam:English|Persian}} -> Persian, or English when that family is off

local hex = (fa ~= "") and T.ColorOf(fam, en) or nil
        if hex then
            return "|cff" .. hex .. fa .. "|r"
        end
        return fa
    end)

    if not seen then
        seen = {}
        tt.wfaAdded = seen
    end
    for _, ln in ipairs(T.Lines(text, wrap, size, mode)) do
        if #ln < 14 or not seen[ln] then
            seen[ln] = true
            tt:AddLine(ln, color[1], color[2], color[3], mode ~= 3)
            style(tt, "Left")
        end
    end

ops.new:
local throttle, pending = 0, false
    F:On("QUEST_LOG_UPDATE", "quests", function()
        local now = GetTime()
        if now - throttle > 0.3 and log_frame() then
            throttle = now
            on_log()
        elseif not pending and log_frame() then
            -- rc9: an update inside the throttle used to be dropped for good, so a quick
            -- second click on the map quest log kept showing the first quest's text:
            -- run once more when the window is over
            pending = true
            F.After(0.35, function()
                pending = false
                if log_frame() then
                    throttle = GetTime()
                    on_log()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

ops.new:
local wrapped = F:Wrap("quests", on_log)
    for _, fn in ipairs({ "SelectQuestLogEntry", "QuestLog_SetSelection" }) do
        if type(_G[fn]) == "function" then
            hooksecurefunc(fn, wrapped)
        end
    end
    -- rc9: the modern map quest log selects a quest through C_QuestLog.SetSelectedQuest /
    -- QuestMapFrame_ShowQuestDetails (none of the old functions run): re-read the
    -- selection right after the click AND once more a moment later (the selection
    -- settles a frame after the call)
    local after_select = F:Wrap("quests", function()
        F.After(0, wrapped)
        F.After(0.2, wrapped)
    end)
    for _, fn in ipairs({ "QuestMapFrame_ShowQuestDetails", "QuestMapFrame_OpenToQuestDetails",
        "QuestMapLogTitleButton_OnClick" }) do
        if type(_G[fn]) == "function" then
            pcall(hooksecurefunc, fn, after_select)
        end
    end
    if type(C_QuestLog) == "table" and type(C_QuestLog.SetSelectedQuest) == "function" then
        pcall(hooksecurefunc, C_QuestLog, "SetSelectedQuest", after_select)
    end

            end
        end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ rc9: colours + no duplicate tooltip lines
local okRc9, errRc9 = pcall(function()
    local T = F.T
    local m = "x {{zn:Elwynn|ZZ}} y {{cls:Rogue|RR}} z {{sp:Frostbolt|SS}}"
    local oldMode, oldCol = F.db.mode, F.db.col
    local savedCode = F.Room.Encode()
    F.Room.Apply("fa")
    F.db.mode = 1
    F.db.col = nil
    check("colours are off until switched on", T.Markers(m) == "x ZZ y RR z SS", T.Markers(m))
    F.db.col = { on = true }
    local out = T.Markers(m)
    check("zone gets the default green", out:find("|cff4cd964ZZ|r", 1, true) ~= nil, out)
    check("a class gets its official colour", out:find("|cfffff569RR|r", 1, true) ~= nil, out)
    check("a spell gets the default blue", out:find("|cff5ac8faSS|r", 1, true) ~= nil, out)
    F.db.col = { on = true, zn = "off", sp = "red" }
    out = T.Markers(m)
    check("a family set to off stays plain, another takes its own colour",
        out:find("x ZZ y", 1, true) ~= nil and out:find("|cffff6b6bSS|r", 1, true) ~= nil, out)
    F.db.mode = 3
    check("no colour codes in display mode 3", T.Markers(m):find("|c", 1, true) == nil)
    F.db.mode = 1
    F.Room.Set("namesZone", false)
    F.db.col = { on = true }
    check("a family that is off shows English, uncoloured", T.Markers(m):find("x Elwynn y", 1, true) ~= nil, T.Markers(m))
    F.Room.Set("namesZone", true)

    F.OpenPanel("colors")
    local PF = F.PanelFrame()
    check("colours page opens", F.PanelPage() == "colors", F.PanelPage())
    F.db.col = nil
    Click(PF.col.zn)
    check("a colour choice cycles and is saved", F.db.col and F.db.col.zn == "blue", F.db.col and F.db.col.zn)
    Click(PF.colOn)
    check("the colour switch turns on", F.db.col.on == true)
    F.db.col, F.db.mode = oldCol, oldMode
    F.Room.Decode(savedCode)
    PF:Hide()

    GameTooltip:Hide()
    GameTooltip:ClearLines()
    T.TipLine(GameTooltip, "A fairly long description line for the tooltip", F.C.text)
    local n1 = GameTooltip:NumLines()
    T.TipLine(GameTooltip, "A fairly long description line for the tooltip", F.C.text)
    check("the same long line is not added twice", GameTooltip:NumLines() == n1, n1 .. " vs " .. GameTooltip:NumLines())
    GameTooltip:Hide()
end)
